To brainstorm ideas for the book report, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Identify recurring motifs in the text (2 hours)
Step 2. Select a primary novel from the reading list (30 minutes)
Step 3. Draft a list of symbolic objects found in the chapters (45 minutes)
Step 4. Write a paragraph summarizing the protagonist's growth (1 hour)
Step 5. Research the historical context of the author's era (3 hours)
Step 6. Compare the book's themes to modern societal issues (2 hours)
Step 7. Check out a biography of the author from the library (1 hour)
Step 8. Interview a classmate about their interpretation (20 minutes)
Step 9. Skim the book's introduction and foreword (15 minutes)
Step 10. Analyze the climax of the story (40 minutes)
Step 11. Create a mind map of character relationships (1 hour)
Step 12. List five major settings described in the plot (20 minutes)
Step 13. Write down potential titles for the report (10 minutes)
Step 14. Find three literary critiques online (50 minutes)
Step 15. Buy a set of colorful sticky notes for tagging (15 minutes)
Step 16. Note the differences between the hero and the villain (30 minutes)
Step 17. Read the first three chapters of the book (2 hours)
Step 18. Synthesize notes into a rough thesis statement (1.5 hours)
Step 19. Watch a short documentary on the book’s subject matter (45 minutes)
Step 20. Brainstorm a list of open-ended discussion questions (30 minutes)
Step 21. Look up definitions for unfamiliar vocabulary (40 minutes)
Step 22. Highlight key quotes regarding the setting (1 hour)
Step 23. Search for a podcast episode discussing the book (5 minutes)
Step 24. Read the book's back cover and jacket notes (5 minutes)
Step 25. Evaluate the pacing of the middle chapters (1 hour)
Step 26. Categorize ideas into "Plot," "Theme," and "Style" (45 minutes)
Step 27. Record a voice memo of initial impressions (10 minutes)
Step 28. Transcribe the voice memo into a digital document (20 minutes)
Step 29. Ask the teacher for clarification on the rubric (5 minutes)
Step 30. Organize the physical workspace for writing (15 minutes)
Step 31. Print out the assignment instructions (2 minutes)
Step 32. Select the final three ideas to develop (15 minutes)
Step 33. Review the list of all brainstormed concepts (10 minutes)
Step 34. Outline the supporting evidence for each idea (1 hour)
Step 35. Summarize the book's resolution (30 minutes)
Step 36. Search for metaphors used by the author (50 minutes)
Step 37. Borrow a copy of the book from a friend (1 day)
Step 38. Reflect on the emotional impact of the ending (30 minutes)
Step 39. Purchase a new notebook for the project (20 minutes)
Step 40. Finalize the list of brainstormed topics (20 minutes)

To make nutella pancakes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a new non-stick spatula (45 minutes)
Step 2. Sift the all-purpose flour into a large bowl (3 minutes)
Step 3. Melt a tablespoon of butter in the microwave (30 seconds)
Step 4. Whisk the wet and dry ingredients together until smooth (2 minutes)
Step 5. Crack the eggs into a separate mixing cup (1 minute)
Step 6. Measure out the whole milk (1 minute)
Step 7. Find the clean mixing bowls in the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 8. Grease the griddle with a light coating of oil (1 minute)
Step 9. Take the jar of Nutella out of the cupboard (15 seconds)
Step 10. Set the table with plates and napkins (3 minutes)
Step 11. Rinse the mixing bowls to ensure they are dust-free (1 minute)
Step 12. Plug in the electric griddle (10 seconds)
Step 13. Combine the milk and eggs into the flour mixture (2 minutes)
Step 14. Check the expiration date on the baking powder (30 seconds)
Step 15. Stir the melted butter into the batter (45 seconds)
Step 16. Prepare a piping bag for the Nutella filling (5 minutes)

Step 18. Measure out the vanilla extract (30 seconds)
Step 19. Add a drop of vanilla to the batter (10 seconds)
Step 20. Locate the vanilla extract in the refrigerator door (1 minute)
Step 21. Scoop Nutella into a small microwave-safe dish (1 minute)
Step 22. Flip the pancakes once bubbles form on the surface (2 minutes)
Step 23. Pour the batter onto the hot griddle (30 seconds)
Step 24. Warm the Nutella slightly to make it spreadable (20 seconds)
Step 25. Mix a pinch of salt and sugar into the dry flour (1 minute)
Step 26. Whisk in the baking powder (30 seconds)
Step 27. Spread a thin layer of Nutella onto a parchment sheet (10 minutes)

Step 1. Season the chips with sea salt (2 minutes)
Step 2. Serve the warm chips in a bowl (1 minute)

Step 20. Pour vegetable oil into the frying pot (1 minute)

Step 36. Fry until the chips are golden brown and crisp (8 minutes)
Step 37. Shake off the excess oil in a wire basket (1 minute)

Step 1. Check the moisture level of the potting medium (1 minute)
Step 2. Mix a balanced orchid fertilizer into a gallon of water (5 minutes)
Step 3. Wipe dust off the leaves with a damp cloth (10 minutes)
Step 4. Inspect the undersides of leaves for pests (3 minutes)
Step 5. Soak the orchid pot in the fertilizer solution (15 minutes)
Step 6. Prepare a humidity tray with pebbles and water (10 minutes)
Step 7. Sterilize pruning shears with rubbing alcohol (2 minutes)

Step 9. Position the plant in a spot with bright, indirect light (2 minutes)
Step 10. Clean the exterior of the decorative cachepot (5 minutes)
Step 11. Measure the ambient room temperature (30 seconds)

Step 19. Check for signs of root rot through the clear liner (2 minutes)
Step 20. Gather all necessary repotting supplies (15 minutes)

question:
To make a chipmunk puppet from a glove, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sketch the chipmunk face pattern on paper (10 minutes)
Step 2. Cut out two small felt circles for the cheeks (2 minutes)
Step 3. Thread a needle with brown embroidery floss (45 seconds)
Step 4. Trim the excess fabric from the pinky finger (3 minutes)
Step 5. Cut the pinky and thumb fingers off the glove (5 minutes)
Step 6. Glue the white felt belly onto the palm (8 minutes)
Step 7. Buy a pair of brown knit gloves (1 hour)
Step 8. Sew the pinky finger hole shut (12 minutes)
Step 9. Select two black beads for the eyes (5 minutes)
Step 10. Lay the glove flat on the workspace (30 seconds)
Step 11. Brush the yarn tail to make it fluffy (4 minutes)
Step 12. Trace the face pattern onto the glove's middle finger (6 minutes)
Step 13. Stitch the black beads onto the face (15 minutes)
Step 14. Apply fabric glue to the back of the eyes (1 minute)
Step 15. Cut out a small triangle of black felt for the nose (3 minutes)
Step 16. Stuff the main body of the glove with polyester fiberfill (10 minutes)
Step 17. Position the cheek circles on the face area (2 minutes)
Step 18. Embroider the whiskers onto the cheeks (20 minutes)
Step 19. Cut three lengths of yarn for the tail (1 minute)
Step 20. Paint small white highlights on the eyes (2 minutes)
Step 21. Cut a strip of white felt for the chipmunk's chest (4 minutes)
Step 22. Sew the yarn tail onto the back of the glove (15 minutes)
Step 23. Insert a cardboard stiffener into the glove cuff (2 minutes)
Step 24. Knot the end of the embroidery floss (30 seconds)
Step 25. Prepare the fabric glue dispenser (2 minutes)
Step 26. Align the chest strip with the center of the glove (3 minutes)
Step 27. Wind the remaining floss onto a bobbin (5 minutes)
Step 28. Construct a small yarn pom-pom for the tail end (10 minutes)
Step 29. Let the entire puppet dry completely (4 hours)
Step 30. Glue the nose triangle onto the middle finger (5 minutes)
Step 31. Gather all crafting supplies (15 minutes)
Step 32. Braid the yarn pieces together (7 minutes)
Step 33. Secure the thread behind the beads (2 minutes)
Step 34. Sew the felt cheeks onto the middle finger (18 minutes)
Step 35. Trim any loose threads from the cheeks (4 minutes)
Step 36. Open a jar of white acrylic paint (30 seconds)
Step 37. Inspect the eye placement for symmetry (1 minute)
Step 38. Apply glue to the edges of the glove cuff (3 minutes)
Step 39. Press the chest strip firmly onto the glue (5 minutes)
Step 40. Wait for the eye glue to set (30 minutes)
